ownership.quote: Render is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with remote team members distributed across the globe.

stage.quote: I'm thrilled to announce that Render has raised $100M in an extension of our Series C, valuing the company at $1.5B, as reported this morning by CNBC.
stage.note: The $100M round is an extension of Render's prior Series C (led by Georgian); per task rules an extension keeps the same stage, so it counts as series-c, not series-d.

total_funding_usd.basis: Company blog states total funding after the Series C extension
total_funding_usd.quote: the round includes strong participation from all our major partners, including Addition, Bessemer, General Catalyst, and 01A, and brings our total funding to $258M.

last_round.quote: Led by Georgian, who also led our Series C, the round includes strong participation from all our major partners, including Addition, Bessemer, General Catalyst, and 01A

note: Founded by Anurag Goel (CEO), ex-Stripe. Independent, VC-backed startup, not a YC company (no listing at ycombinator.com/companies/render). Funding history: ~$2M seed (Apr 2019) -> $20M Series A led by Addition (Nov 2021, brought total to $26.75M) -> $50M Series B led by Bessemer Venture Partners (Jun 2023) -> Series C led by Georgian -> $100M Series C extension led by Georgian (Feb 2026), $1.5B valuation, $258M total raised. Reported 4.5M+ developers on the platform and >250,000 new developers joining monthly as of Feb 2026.
